_about: Several GPUs in one machine, GPUlayer Trainer vs PyTorch Lightning 2.6.6 (multigpu-v4-final.log). Vast.ai 4x RTX 3070 8 GB, Intel Xeon E5-2673 v4 (2 sockets; GPU 0 on one, GPUs 1-3 on the other, 2-3 behind one PCIe switch), torch 2.15.0+cu132. DDP over NCCL, batch per GPU (CNN 128, MLP 256), defaults for both trainers; GPUlayer passes its loader as a function (built only where training runs). Read by scripts/make_perf_charts.py.

multi_gpu.subtitle: 4x RTX 3070 (Vast.ai), DDP over NCCL, batch per GPU, each trainer's defaults
